notes.content: 1. Access the University Catalog for Programs and Degrees, General Education Requirements, and Graduation Requirements at CSUCI. 2. notes.contentHtml:
1. Access the University Catalog for Programs and Degrees, General Education Requirements, and Graduation Requirements at CSUCI.

2. Access the Program Website and Program Information in the University Catalog.

3. Access Freshman 4-year Academic Roadmap.

4. Access the Admissions website for CSUCI admission requirements.

5. Access the Transfer Credit website for information about Associate Degrees for Transfer, and transfer credit resources for external exams and U.S. Military service.

6. Learn more About CSUCI.

Articulation agreements are subject to change from one academic year to the next. It is recommended to review the applicable department agreement(s) in addition to the major agreement and that students meet with a counselor/academic advisor early and often during their academic career.

notes.content: 1. The Nursing, B.S.N. Program uses the cohort model of course scheduling and requires full-time enrollment. Students move as a group through a designated sequence of nursing courses. 2. For information about the application process for the nursing program, please visit their website at https://nursing.csuci.edu , or email them at nursing@csuci.edu. 3. Special Grade Requirement: Nursing majors must attain grades of "C" or better in all courses. 4. For the Nursing, B.S.N. major only, courses satisfying the CSU American Institutions Requirement are allowed to double-count with the General Education Area D (GE area 4) requirement.
notes.contentHtml:
1. The Nursing, B.S.N. Program uses the cohort model of course scheduling and requires full-time enrollment. Students move as a group through a designated sequence of nursing courses.

2. For information about the application process for the nursing program, please visit their website at https://nursing.csuci.edu, or email them at nursing@csuci.edu.

3. Special Grade Requirement: Nursing majors must attain grades of "C" or better in all courses.

4. For the Nursing, B.S.N. major only, courses satisfying the CSU American Institutions Requirement are allowed to double-count with the General Education Area D (GE area 4) requirement.
